english.title: Fail without reasonable excuse to notify police of name or home address
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being subject to

(A)_[a knife crime prevention order, made on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY COURT..),]_
(B)_[an interim knife crime prevention order made on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY COURT..),]_

failed without reasonable excuse, to notify the police of

(C)_[your name or each of your names]_
(D)_[your home address]_

within 3 days of the order taking effect
english.legislation: Contrary to section 25(1)(a) and (2) of the Offensive Weapons Act 2019.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Only relates to a knife crime prevention order (KCPO) / interim KCPO applied or made in the metropolitan police district for the period beginning with 5th July 2021 and ending with 31st March 2023.
(ii) A person can only give notice by the means set out in section 24(7).

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine. Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
